svg.title: How the apps work together
svg.desc: You ask for something in Seerr. Radarr and Sonarr search through Prowlarr, qBittorrent downloads it into your library, Bazarr adds subtitles, and Jellyfin plays it. The numbers are the standard ports.
svg.text: ask for a show or film
Jellyfin plays what is in your library
The numbers are the standard ports. If one is busy, the setup picks a free one. Logos belong to their projects.
